description: This file defines the DigitalProduct entity class, representing a digital product linked to a Product within an e-commerce system. It maps to the PRODUCT_DIGITAL database table with JPA annotations and includes fields for ID, product reference, and filename.

classes.name: DigitalProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a digital product in the catalog, with fields for ID, associated Product, and filename.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the digital product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the digital product.

methods.name: getProductFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the digital product.

methods.name: setProductFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the digital product.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the Product entity associated with this digital product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product entity with this digital product.
